name: genkit-agent-functions
description: Serve Genkit agents from Firebase Cloud Functions with per-user sessions and turn locking

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm --filter genkit-agent-kit build && pnpm --filter genkit-agent-chat build
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-kit/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/agent-kit/tests/emulator/app/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:emulator: pnpm build && pnpm --filter emulator-app build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-test --config tests/emulator/firebase.json --only functions,firestore,auth "vitest run --config vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.test:kit: pnpm build && pnpm --filter agent-kit-test-app build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-test --config packages/agent-kit/tests/emulator/firebase.json --only functions,firestore,auth "vitest run --config packages/agent-kit/vitest.emulator.config.ts"
scripts.test:cli: pnpm build && pnpm --filter emulator-app build && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-test --config tests/emulator/firebase.json --only functions,firestore,auth "vitest run --config packages/cli/vitest.emulator.config.ts"
